get.description: Webhook subscriptions deliver member, appointment and payment lifecycle events to your server as signed POST requests (`X-Gymflexa-Signature: t=<timestamp>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "timestamp.body">`). An endpoint failing 20 times in a row is disabled automatically. Subscriptions are managed with an operator access token; the `secret` is only returned once, on create.

post.description: The response includes the signing `secret` exactly once — store it; it cannot be retrieved again.

events.description: Empty array subscribes to all events

200.description: The created subscription, including its secret

put.description: `url`, `events` and `active` are editable; the secret and gym are immutable. Re-enabling an auto-disabled endpoint is done by setting `active` back to true.

apiKey.description: HTTP Basic auth carrying only the API key secret: Authorization: Basic base64(<key secret>).

accessToken.name: Authorization
accessToken.description: Operator session token issued by the GymFlexa dashboard: Authorization: Token <access token>.

secret.description: Signing secret returned exactly once on creation.
